pattern: Subroutine result in a caller's local
symptom: A subroutine writes 1@ and the calling thread's own 1@ changes
check: Grep each calling thread for the local the subroutine writes
fix: Return the result through a global read before the next wait, or pick a local no caller uses

symptom: 1@ == true reads as if 1@ were a flag
check: Look for N@ compared with true or false
fix: Comment the first use of the local, or use a global with a name
